_provenance.method: sitemap inventory + structural probes (h1/h2 outline, form/table/img counts) on representative pages per cluster
_provenance.scope: the 83 confident-migrate pages (coreNav + destinationHubs + itineraryDetail + blogPosts); 41 taxonomy pages flagged review, 5 junk excluded

templates.name: Homepage
templates.structure: hero, enquiry, packages (cards), welcome, features, destinations mosaic, testimonial, themes, cta-band, blog grid

templates.name: Destination hub (*-tour-packages)
templates.structure: hero (destination) · 'Why Visit <Dest>?' prose intro · 'Our Popular Tour Packages' card grid (links to itinerary-detail pages) · enquiry form · related destinations
newBlocksNeeded: prose-intro (heading + body + supporting image; likely default content, not a block)

templates.name: Tour / experience detail
templates.structure: hero (tour title + duration) · Tour Overview (prose) · Tour Itinerary (day-by-day OR numbered stops — accordion/list) · Package Inclusions · Package Exclusions · enquiry/booking form · related tours

variants.note: N-days/N-nights itineraries with day-by-day breakdown (h3 per day)
half-day / single experiences with numbered stops (walking/food/cycle/desert/sightseeing tours, TTC courses)

newBlocksNeeded: inclusions (two-column check/cross list — likely 'columns' or a new 'spec-list' block)
templates.membersNote: 26 multi-day + 21 experience = 47; full list in site-inventory.json § itineraryDetail

templates.name: Blog article
templates.structure: article hero (title + hero image) · long-form body (h2/h3 sections, prose, images, lists) · related posts · enquiry/newsletter
newBlocksNeeded: article-body (default content: headings + prose + inline images — mostly native, no block)

templates.name: Simple content page
templates.structure: hero · prose body (mission/story) · feature or values strip · enquiry

templates.name: Listing / index page
templates.structure: hero · large filterable grid of destination/blog tiles (23+ imgs) · enquiry
newBlocksNeeded: listing-grid (reuse destinations/blog card grid at scale)

templates.name: Contact page
templates.structure: hero · 'Get In Touch' contact facts · 'Enquire Now' form · map/location

summary.note: home(1) + destination-hub(21) + tour-detail(47) + blog-post(10) + content-simple(2) + listing(2) + contact(1) = 84. '/activity' listing folds into listing template; counts reconcile to the 83 confident-migrate set + home.
summary.buildLeverage: 7 templates cover 84 pages. Build 1 archetype per template (6 new, home already done), verify, then apply each template across its members — instead of 83 bespoke builds.
